facts.fact: The Togo Digital 2025 strategy (April 2021) plans, under access to basic social services, the digitalisation of care pathways alongside the roll-out of universal health coverage, including a digital and centralised medical record, online appointment booking and a digital vaccination booklet, and lists 'constitution of a single medical record' among the public services to digitise; it describes these as to be developed, not as existing.
